name: io.github.vince-gonzalez/saydo
title: SayDo
description: Does the tool do what it says? Reports whether an MCP tool was observed behaving the way its author declared, and answers 'unknown' for anything nobody has checked.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server sits behind an optional dependency so the library and harness stay installable without the SDK.
The stdio server entry point. Full command: uvx --from 'saydo[mcp]' saydo-mcp
